# PI-MVP-001 — Semantic Foundation

**Status:** ACTIVE
**Forecast:** 2026-08-17 through 2026-09-13

## Objective

Build the deterministic semantic kernel needed to turn canonical repository artifacts into validated graph/KIR state.

## Work Cycles

- WC-MVP-0001 Workspace, discovery, identity
- WC-MVP-0002 Parsing and reference resolution
- WC-MVP-0003 Semantic graph
- WC-MVP-0004 KIR and diagnostics

## Included Work Packets

WP-MVP-0001 through WP-MVP-0012.

## Exit

M-001 Semantic Kernel Alpha acceptance passes with reproducibility, graph provenance, KIR validation, and diagnostic evidence.
